controls.instruction: When the source claim concerns a pattern, economic relation or institutional function, make that already-supported concept the grammatical theme; keep evidence sources and actor roles explicit.
controls.guard: No added importance ranking, centrality, universality, agent reassignment or economic relation. Reframing must not become a new definition.

controls.instruction: Where the source explicitly supports an inference or causal consequence, consider a finite consequence clause with a clear existing subject rather than only a participial tail, while retaining the same claim grouping.
controls.guard: Require the existing explicit source relation and unchanged endpoints/direction/certainty. Keep conditions and modality attached; do not infer causality from co-location.

controls.instruction: Prefer a compact referent/cohort/quantity label already present and defined in the source over gratuitous synonymous renaming, when it improves continuity.
controls.guard: Only source-defined labels; no target-derived glossary, new technical alias, unit/value conversion or changed population/scope. Pronouns can remain when clearer.

global_note: No universal nominalization/formality/finite-clause rule and no author specificity demonstrated.
